objective: Independently verify that a general Worker OMP receives a complete response contract and that actual probes construct responses only from that delivered contract.
required_attacks: Inspect delivered execute and analysis messages for exact marker, version, compact-frame instruction, field order/descriptors/types/values, allowed decisions, response_id UUID generation rule, and no prose/tool/thinking instruction.

Prove parser and contract cannot drift under reordered/missing/extra descriptor, marker mutation, identity mutation, decision-set mutation, response-id rule mutation, or natural-language-only instructions.
Prove the actual scripted provider has no hardcoded marker/response identity/schema fallback: it must fail or emit the contract mutation when contract data changes.
Run actual OMP 18.2.10 two-stage flow with contract-derived frames, all public response attacks, regressions, privacy and residue checks.
constraints: Do not modify product, existing worker tests/probes, docs, workflow artifacts, dependencies, or unrelated files.
Use apply_patch for independent test changes. Preserve failing product evidence and report needs_reroute rather than fixing product.
No commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean. Run graphify update . after test changes and report generated drift separately.
report: snapshot/scope audit and candidate_ready or needs_reroute
